1035.description: A machine move that pulls the leg across the body, working the inner thighs.
instructions: Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1099.description: A split squat holding the handles for help. It trains the legs and balance.
instructions: Hold the handles and place your back foot behind you.
Stand tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Use your arms for light help.
Press up through your front heel.
Switch legs.

1163.description: A floor exercise that raises straight legs to hit the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

1227.description: A single-arm pushdown with an overhand grip. It isolates one triceps at a time.
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the handle with an overhand grip and tuck your elbow to your side.
Push down until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps, then let the handle rise slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1291.description: A pullover with one dumbbell while your upper back rests on a stability ball. It stretches the chest and lats and asks your core to stay braced.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell with one hand and extend your arm straight up above your chest.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head while keeping your arm straight.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
用一只手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1355.description: Stand facing a wall and press one arm into it while you lean in. It switches on the lats and shoulder with no equipment.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out in front of you and place your palm against the wall.
Engage your core and lean your body forward, keeping your arm straight and your back flat.
Slowly push against the wall with your palm, activating your lat muscles.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and repeat with the other arm.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只手臂伸直到身前，将手掌靠在墙上。
启动你的核心，身体向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，背部平坦。
用手掌慢慢推向墙壁，激活背阔肌。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后松开并用另一只手臂重复该动作。

1419.description: Lie on your back with your arms out and cross one leg over your body toward the opposite hand. It stretches the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended out to the sides.
Raise your legs up towards the ceiling, keeping them straight.
Slowly lower your legs to one side, aiming to touch the floor with your feet.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then return your legs to the starting position.
Repeat the stretch on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双臂向两侧伸展。
将双腿抬向天花板，保持伸直。
慢慢地将双腿降低到一侧，旨在用脚接触地板。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后将双腿恢复到起始位置。
在另一侧重复拉伸。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1483.description: A seated yoga posture with both feet resting on opposite thighs. It opens the hips and needs good flexibility.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended.
Bring one foot onto the opposite thigh, then the other foot on top of the other thigh.
Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch the leg order next time.

1547.description: Standing on one leg, you curl the other against a low cable. It isolates the hamstrings one side at a time.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it around one ankle.
Stand facing the machine and hold on for balance, with the working leg slightly behind you.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without swinging your torso.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

1611.description: Holding a dumbbell behind your back, you roll it down to your fingertips and curl it back up. It builds finger and forearm flexor strength and grip.
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell held in one hand behind your back.
Let the dumbbell roll down until it rests on your fingertips.
Close your fingers and curl the weight back into your palm.
Keep your wrist still and your arm close to your body.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch hands.

1675.description: A reverse spider curl with both dumbbells, chest down on a bench. It trains the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1739.description: Standing kickbacks done one arm at a time with a hinged torso. Trains the triceps with a strong squeeze at full extension.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides with each repetition.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述动作，每次重复时交替进行。

1803.description: Seated and folding forward, you stretch the muscles along your lower back. A gentle way to ease lower back tightness.
instructions: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1867.description: Seated machine move that squeezes the legs together to train the inner thighs.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Place your legs against the pads, set wide.
Squeeze your legs together smoothly.
Pause for a moment when they meet.
Open slowly back to the start.

1931.description: A deep squat hold that opens the hips and loosens the knees and ankles.
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2123.description: With help from a partner, this stretch lengthens the oblique muscles on the side of the trunk through a slow bend or twist.
instructions: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead while your partner steadies your hips.
Lean away from the raised arm while your partner gently guides your arm.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come back to upright and switch sides.

2187.description: A close-grip bench press using a reverse (underhand) grip. Emphasises the triceps and upper chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
反握抓住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将杠铃向胸部降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃位于胸部正上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

2315.description: A seated rotary calf raise on a machine. Builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖稍微弯曲，双脚平放在踏板上。
将脚趾放在踏板上，脚跟悬在踏板边缘。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
用脚掌推动，尽可能高地抬高脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2571.description: A rocking frog stretch that opens the hips and inner thighs. Helps loosen the glutes and groin.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Slowly lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands and extending your legs behind you.
Keep your back straight and engage your glutes as you push your hips back and up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your knees and lowering your hips back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上以获得支撑。
慢慢向前倾，将重心转移到双手上，并将双腿伸到身后。
当你将臀部向后推向天花板时，保持背部挺直并收紧臀部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，感受臀部的拉伸。
弯曲膝盖并降低臀部，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2763.description: Straightening the elbow from a bent position, which works the back of the upper arm and keeps the joint moving.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your upper arm still with the elbow bent.
Straighten the arm slowly until it is almost fully extended.
Pause briefly, keeping the shoulder relaxed and the upper arm fixed.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2891.description: Fast alternating leg lifts with your head raised that fire up the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands tucked under your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise both legs a few inches above the ground.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating pulses.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe steadily.

3019.description: A bodyweight bench pull-up variation hanging beneath a bar. Works the lats and biceps.
instructions: Position yourself under a bar or a sturdy horizontal surface that is at chest height.
Grab the bar or surface with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Pull your chest towards the bar or surface by squeezing your shoulder blades together and bending your elbows.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar or surface.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己置于与胸部同高的横杆或坚固的水平表面下方。
正手握住杠铃或杠铃表面，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃或地面。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杆或表面上方。
有控制地降低自己回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3083.description: A seated curl that keeps the body steady while the biceps do the work.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and keep elbows pinned.
Lower slowly to full extension.

3147.description: A small rocking movement of the pelvis while lying on your back. It wakes up the abs and teaches you to control the position of your lower back.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides.
Engage your abs and tilt your pelvis upward, pressing your lower back into the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, focusing on contracting your abs.
Release the tilt and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，向上倾斜骨盆，将下背部压入地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩腹肌。
释放倾斜并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3211.description: A beginner-friendly push-up with the knees on the floor. It builds chest, shoulder and triceps strength with less load than a standard push-up.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, so that your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground, then push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，使身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，保持核心靠近身体两侧，将身体压向地面。
继续降低，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后伸直手臂，将其推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3339.description: A lunge holding a dumbbell in one hand. The uneven load makes your core work to keep you balanced.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.

3403.description: Raise your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the lower traps and shoulder stabilisers.
instructions: Stand tall with arms by your sides, thumbs pointing up.
Raise both arms diagonally overhead to form a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck long and avoid shrugging.

3467.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 7 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3531.description: Alternating punches at a steady pace to raise the heart rate.
instructions: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep your core tight.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

3659.description: Hold a tall standing posture as a reference position.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft.
Stack ribs over hips and shoulders back.
Let your arms hang.
Hold and breathe steadily.

3723.description: A lunge where you step diagonally behind you with a barbell on your back. It works the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.

3787.description: A hip hinge paired with a one-arm band row. It works your posterior chain and your upper back.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand with soft knees and the band under light tension.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then row the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3851.description: A hammer curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

3915.description: A harder pike push-up with the feet raised, hands on benches, loading the shoulders strongly.
instructions: Place your hands on two benches and your feet on a higher surface behind you.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Control the descent.

3979.description: A push up where one hand crosses over toward the other side. It adds an uneven challenge for the chest and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Push up and cross one hand over toward the other side.
Place it down and repeat.
Alternate the crossing hand.

4043.description: Hanging from parallel bars, you shrug your shoulder blades up and down. It builds the traps and shoulder control.
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and hang in an inverted position with arms straight.
Keep your body stable and your elbows locked.
Draw your shoulder blades down and together, pulling your body up a little.
Lower back to a full hang under control.
Repeat for controlled reps.

4107.description: A sumo deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, shortening the pull and loading hips, legs and back.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes out in front of a bar on blocks.
Grip the bar inside your knees and set a flat back.
Push the floor apart with your feet and stand up.
Lock out by squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

4171.description: A partial deadlift from knee height on a Smith machine. It overloads the back and hips.
instructions: Set the bar at knee height in the Smith machine.
Grip the bar and set your back flat.
Drive through your feet and extend your hips.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Lower the bar to the start with control.
Keep the bar close to your legs.

4235.description: A seated bent-over row with elbows flared wide to hit the rear delts. Sitting keeps your legs from helping.
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward with a flat back, arms hanging.
Pull the weights toward your sides with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest close to your thighs.

4299.description: A stretch for the front of the thigh done lying on your side or front. It loosens tight quads after leg work.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head resting on one arm.
Bend the top knee and grab that ankle with your top hand.
Pull your heel toward your glutes while keeping your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

4363.description: A single-leg squat with arms forward as a counterweight. It builds balance and strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg and extend the other behind you.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Bend your standing knee and lower slowly.
Touch lightly with your back knee if needed.
Drive back up and switch legs.

4491.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the lower trapezius. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your lower trapezius while leaning back against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4555.description: A flowing hip rotation drill that moves the hips through internal and external rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, feet wide.
Lean back a little and support yourself with your hands.
Rotate both knees to one side so they drop toward the floor.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your movements slow and controlled.
Continue for 10-12 reps per side.

4619.description: A neutral-grip curl against band tension that builds the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

4683.description: A squat with band resistance. It builds the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down.
Go to at least parallel without letting your knees cave in.
Drive up through your heels and repeat.

4747.description: A woodchop done lying on your back, moving a dumbbell diagonally across your body. It works the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Sweep the dumbbell diagonally up and across to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso with the movement.
Return under control and switch sides after the set.

4811.description: A side plank hold, a second variation. It strengthens the obliques and the muscles that keep your trunk stable.
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm under your shoulder.
Stack or stagger your feet.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your neck neutral and your core tight.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

4875.description: A standing stretch that opens up the back. It is a gentle way to loosen tight muscles along the spine.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of you and press your arms forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin slightly.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades and along the spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and stand tall.

4939.description: A prone superman with a rowing motion of the arms. It targets the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull your elbows back toward your ribs as if rowing.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms forward again.
Keep your neck neutral.

5003.description: One-legged calf raise from a stair step for a deep stretch. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a stair on one foot, holding the rail for balance.
Let your heel drop below the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

5067.description: Press two dumbbells held together up from an incline bench. The constant squeeze keeps the chest working through the whole rep.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back with dumbbells pressed together over your chest.
Keep squeezing them against each other the whole set.
Lower them slowly to your upper chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched back and feet planted.

5131.description: A seated move tapping toward your neck area. It gently mobilises the neck and shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Bring one hand up toward the side of your neck.
Tap lightly.
Switch to the other hand.
Keep your head level.
Continue at a gentle pace.

5195.description: A seated lateral neck stretch. It loosens the side of the neck and upper traps.
instructions: Sit tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your ear toward one shoulder.
Rest your hand lightly on your head for a gentle added stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and switch sides.

5387.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the lower back muscles. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your lower back.
Place the roller under the lower back muscles and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly with small movements and keep your core engaged.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5451.description: A glute bridge with a barbell across your hips and a knees-forward setup. Keeps tension on the glutes through the whole rep.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.

5515.description: Sit-up on a decline bench that increases the range and load on the abs.
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Lower back slowly without dropping.
Keep your neck relaxed.

5579.description: Seated wrist curl with an EZ bar to build the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs and wrists past your knees.
Hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Lower the bar by opening your fingers slightly.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Keep your forearms still.

5899.description: A chair squat with a twist. Strengthens the legs while rotating the spine.
instructions: Stand and sink your hips back into a chair pose.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook one elbow outside the opposite knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your knees together.
Untwist and repeat on the other side.

5963.description: A sit-up performed with the legs raised vertically, which keeps the focus on the abs by taking the hip flexors out of the pull.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Pause at the top.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.

6027.description: A shadow-boxing drill pairing a forward step with a punch for cardio and coordination.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Return to your stance.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.

6219.description: A standing fly on a cable, one arm at a time. It builds the chest.
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable with the handle at chest height.
Step forward for balance.
Pull the handle across your body.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6539.description: A kneeling stretch that opens up your shoulders and lats as you sink your chest toward the floor.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest.
Let your forehead rest near the floor.
Relax your shoulders and breathe deeply.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

6795.description: The frontal-view version of the Thomas test, checking for tight hip flexors and inner thighs while you lie on a bench.
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench and lie back, pulling one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang down off the edge, fully relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your pelvis still.
Watch whether the hanging leg drifts outward or the thigh lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

7499.description: Conditioning combo of two plank jacks followed by four mountain climbers.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
Keep your hips level.
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.

7563.description: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

7627.description: A reverse lunge while pressing a landmine bar overhead. It trains the legs, glutes and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you rise, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulder while you lunge back again.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

7883.description: A deadlift with the end of a landmine bar, easier on the back and good for hips and hamstrings.
instructions: Load one end of the barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet hip-width.
Hinge back and grip the bar end with both hands.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Lower the bar under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

8075.description: A one-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell across your hips. It hits the glutes hard and shows up strength imbalances.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

8203.description: A Russian twist done seated on a chair. It works the obliques with low impact.
instructions: Sit near the edge of a chair and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall.

8331.description: A kettlebell circle around the head from a half kneeling stance that mobilises the shoulders and challenges core stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold the kettlebell upside down at chest height.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Circle the bell around your head slowly, keeping it close.
Complete the reps, then reverse the direction.
Switch the kneeling leg and repeat.

8971.description: Sinking into a wide side lunge stretches the inner thigh and groin. A good opener before lower body work.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

9611.description: A forward lunge with your arms stretched overhead, adding a core and shoulder challenge to the leg work.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

9803.description: Leaning against a wall, you lift your toes toward your shins to train the muscle at the front of your lower leg.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a little forward.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes as high as you can, keeping your heels down.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

9867.description: A cable reverse fly with a palms-up grip, angled at 45 degrees to hit the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand at a cable station and grab the handles with palms up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

9931.description: A curl performed chest-down on an incline bench so the arms hang straight. It removes swing and puts the stress on the biceps.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.

9995.description: A static hold where you press the back of your hand upward against resistance. It strengthens the wrist extensors without moving the joint.
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
Relax slowly.
Repeat, then switch arms.

10187.description: A vertical jump followed by a hop to the side, building leg power and agility.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly and immediately hop sideways to one side.
Land on both feet with soft knees and reset your balance.
Alternate the side of each hop and keep a steady rhythm.

10763.description: A one-leg seated hamstring curl on a plate-loaded machine. It builds each hamstring separately.
instructions: Sit on the machine and set the pad above your ankle.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl one leg down and back.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

11275.description: A side plank held while you row a cable. It trains the core, shoulders and back at the same time.
instructions: Set up in a side plank with a low cable handle in your top hand.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Row the handle toward your ribs.
Keep your hips high and stable.
Extend slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

11787.description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the median nerve running down the arm to the hand.
instructions: Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up.
Extend your wrist and fingers backward.
Tilt your head slightly away from that arm.
Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times.
Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.

0011.description: A hanging knee raise with machine or band assistance. Builds lower ab and hip flexor strength.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core muscles and lift your knees towards your chest, bending at the hips and knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
调动你的核心肌肉，将膝盖抬向胸部，弯曲臀部和膝盖。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压腹肌。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0075.description: Bent over, you raise the bar with straight arms to shoulder height. Targets the rear delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise the barbell out to the sides, keeping your arms straight, until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将杠铃向两侧举起，保持手臂伸直，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0139.description: A pull-up with a narrow grip. Emphasises the biceps and lats.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull yourself up towards the bar, focusing on using your biceps to lift your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并将自己拉向杠铃，专注于使用二头肌来抬起你的身体。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0203.description: A bent-over cable row with a rope, pulling toward the face and chest. It builds the rear delts and the upper back.
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a low pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope handle with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and pull the rope towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索手柄连接到低滑轮电缆机器上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住绳索手柄，手掌相对。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，将绳子拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0267.description: A crunch with the arms stretched overhead. Reaching long makes the move harder and works the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms straight above your head.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双臂伸直至头顶上方。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，向前向膝盖弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0331.description: An incline fly with a wrist twist at the bottom. The rotation adds a squeeze to the upper chest.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Lie back on the bench and press the dumbbells up to the starting position, directly above your chest, with your arms extended.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
As you lower the dumbbells, rotate your wrists so that your palms face forward at the bottom of the movement.
Reverse the motion and bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position, squeezing your chest muscles together at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心相对。
仰卧在长凳上，将哑铃推至起始位置，位于胸部正上方，双臂伸展。
将哑铃以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
放下哑铃时，旋转手腕，使手掌在动作底部朝前。
反转动作，将哑铃拉回起始位置，在顶部将胸部肌肉挤压在一起。
重复所需的重复次数。

0395.description: A seated lateral raise, second variation. It builds the side of the shoulders with strict form.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the dumbbells to your sides with a slight bend in your elbows, until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将哑铃举至身体两侧，肘部稍微弯曲，直到手臂与地面平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0459.description: You lie on your back and kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your hands by your sides.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground about 6 inches.
Keeping your legs straight, alternate lifting one leg slightly higher than the other.
Continue this fluttering motion for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双手放在身体两侧。
收紧核心肌群并将双腿抬离地面约 6 英寸。
保持双腿伸直，交替将一条腿抬得比另一条腿稍高。
继续这个颤动动作达到所需的重复次数。

0523.description: You press kettlebells overhead while rotating your palms. It trains all three parts of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing towards you.
Engage your core and press the kettlebells overhead, rotating your palms to face forward as you extend your arms.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the kettlebells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个壶铃，与肩同高，手掌朝向自己。
启动你的核心并将壶铃压过头顶，在伸展手臂时旋转手掌以面向前方。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0587.description: On a machine, you press the handles overhead from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, but do not lock your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向上推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但不要锁住肘部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0651.description: You hang from a bar with a neutral grip and pull your chin above it. Works the lats and biceps with a shoulder friendly grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 用中立握法（手掌相对）悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
弯曲肘部并将肘部向下推向臀部，将身体向上拉向杠铃。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后有控制地慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0715.description: A sideways plank balanced on one forearm. It builds strength in the obliques and the muscles that stabilise your trunk.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your hips high and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Don't let your hips drop or roll forward.

0843.description: A weighted inner-thigh squeeze, bringing the legs together in a triangle shape. It works the adductors.
instructions: Sit or lie with knees bent and a weight resting on your thighs.
Let your knees open into a triangle.
Squeeze your knees together against the weight.
Pause briefly.
Open slowly and repeat.

0907.description: A lateral raise with a band. It builds the side delts.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly under control.
Avoid shrugging.

0971.description: An ab wheel rollout with a band to help bring you back. It trains the abs with a lighter load.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and hold the handles of the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Place the band on the ground in front of you and position your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the furthest point, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 跪在地板上，双手握住弹力带的手柄，手掌朝下。
将弹力带放在您面前的地面上，双手分开与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并缓慢地向前滚动轮子，在保持控制的同时尽可能地伸展你的身体。
在最远点暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将轮子向膝盖方向滚动，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
